Position Description & Qualifications

Serco-NA is seeking a motivated individual to serve as an IB-CHE/PMDT Developer in the Submarine Industrial Base Data Analytics Team, (IB-CHE: Industrial Base – Cloud Hosting Environment/ PMDT: Product & Manufacturing Digital Twin) supporting high-visibility initiatives that enhance the readiness, resilience, and performance of the U.S. Navy’s Submarine Industrial Base (SIB).

Must be able to obtain U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.

In this role, you will systematically map, analyze, and plan the digital transformation efforts across all areas/departments. The core deliverable is a comprehensive portfolio that outlines current capabilities, future requirements, and strategic roadmaps for technology integration, ensuring all digital investments are aligned, and directly support mission objectives.

This position operates in a fast-paced environment requiring daily interaction with suppliers, government stakeholders, and industry partners. You must be a self-starter capable of independently identifying issues, analyzing complex datasets, developing actionable insights, and communicating performance outcomes to senior leadership.

Working remotely, you will be on the dynamic SIB Data Team providing support to the Program Manager and DRPM SUB where you will help manage a dynamic mix of in-house development teams and third-party tool integration projects to deliver solutions that support the SIB program. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors.

Program Overview

The Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) Program leads the U.S. Navy's effort to revitalize America's shipbuilding and repair capabilities. Established in September 2024, the program strengthens and expands the industrial base that builds and maintains surface ships, aircraft carriers, and submarines vital to national defense.

https://www.secnav.navy.mil/rda/mib/Pages/default.aspx

DRPM Subs Is Responsible For

The acquisition of COLUMBIA Class Submarines, including R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E), and Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E). This program is a major defense acquisition effort with significant Congressional and OSD visibility.The acquisition of VIRGINIA Class Submarines, including lifecycle management, T&E, LFT&E, and Fleet introduction, with an estimated lifecycle cost of $336B.The SSN(X) program, responsible for next-generation fast attack submarine design and acquisition, emphasizing speed, stealth, payload capacity, and operational endurance.

Serco supports the US Navy as prime for SHAPM contract supporting the acquisition of submarines and surface vessels.

In This Role, You Will

Build Web Sites on Gov Cloud: Design and update website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript standards.Connect Back-End Services: Integrate and develop APIs to Gov Cloud databases and external web services.Optimize Performance: Ensure fast page loading speeds, mobile responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility.Troubleshoot and Test: Monitor site performance, fix bugs, and run quality checks.Reviews, analyzes, and modifies programming systems including encoding, testing, debugging and documenting programsExperience with Industry 4.0., Additive Manufacturing, and Non-Destructive Testing workflows.Help fill any knowledge gap in digital requirements for Industry 4.0 to enable and then eventually sustain them beyond MVP status (includes things such as data lakes, S3 buckets, ATOs, possible IB-CHE integration dynamics, operational costs, etc).Familiar with a variety of field’s concepts, practices, and procedures.Support data ingestion, processing, and visualization workflows to deliver actionable insights to government stakeholders.Collaborate with a cross-functional team of analysts, data engineers, front-end developers, and subject matter experts to deliver mission-critical solutions.Present findings through reports, dashboards, and briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences.Performs a variety of complicated tasks.Report progress and metrics to the Data Director and other senior stakeholders.Provide program, analytical, and acquisition management support to senior level SIB executives as required.Work with the SIB team, which is spread across the United States focused on workforce development/marketing, supply chain/sustainment, and technology developments.Interact with industry and senior leadership.Contribute to the development of data-driven insights and analytic solutions that help identify, assess, and mitigate risks in complex supply chains.You will partner closely with Product Owners, the Data Director, and other stakeholders to maintain delivery cadence, transparency, and accountability.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have

The ability to obtain a DoW Secret security clearance.A Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics, Industry 4.0, or applied machine learning or similar/related experience.Technical Knowledge: Strong command of development languages HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.Programming Languages: Familiarity with backend languages or frameworks (such as PHP, Python, Ruby on Rails, or Node.js).Tools and CMS: Experience with version control tools (like Git).Gov Cloud CyberSecurity: Experience developing cybersecure and certified websites on DoW Networks. Rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical insights clearly.Strong communication (both written and oral), facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills.A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. Customer-oriented team player mindset focused on mission who is self-motivated, driven and can work independently and remotely.The ability to travel 10%.

If you feel your skillset is a match to the requirements, then you should be ready to take the next step in your career path, apply today!

Company Overview

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Description

The GO-AI Operations team is building the future of workplace safety at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers through an advanced AI-powered human detection system rated at SIL2 (Safety Integrity Level 2), achieving up to 99% accuracy in identifying human presence. The team works at the intersection of computer vision and operational safety, processing multi-modal image data — including RGB, thermal, and grayscale feeds — to train and validate ML models that protect associates on the fulfillment floor. As an Associate in this role, you will perform high-quality 2D image annotation, accurately segmenting humans, robots, and carts within defined Regions of Interest (ROI). Your work directly enables the ML pipeline that powers real-time safety decisions, making this a high-impact, metrics-driven operational role where precision and consistency are critical. If you thrive in structured environments, have a sharp eye for detail, and want your work to directly contribute to associate safety at scale, this is the role for you

Key job responsibilities

Perform accurate 2D segmentation and annotation of humans, robots, and carts across RGB and thermal images using annotation tools (e.g., CVAT, SageMaker Ground Truth)

Identify and annotate objects within the defined Region of Interest (ROI), while applying masks outside the ROI as per guidelines

Interpret multi-feed image data (RGB, thermal, grayscale) with high precision, distinguishing between overlapping or partially occluded objects

Maintain high accuracy and productivity metrics aligned with program expectations and weekly targets

Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and quality guidelines consistently across all annotation tasks

Review and validate annotations to ensure defect-free outputs, flagging edge cases or ambiguous frames for escalation

Quickly adapt to feedback from quality audits and apply learnings to improve annotation quality in subsequent batches

Participate in training and nesting phases, achieving ramp-up within defined timelines and demonstrating readiness through qualification assessments

Maintain data confidentiality and adhere to security protocols when handling image and video data from fulfillment centers

Collaborate with team leads and quality analysts to support continuous improvement in annotation accuracy and throughput

A day in the life

Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.

Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.

About The Team

The GO-AI Operations team is part of Amazon's Global Operations AI organization, enabling automation and workplace safety at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. The team supports an advanced SIL2-rated human detection system achieving up to 99% accuracy in identifying human presence within robotic work cells. By processing multi-modal image data — RGB, thermal, and grayscale — the team performs high-quality 2D segmentation and annotation of humans, robots, and carts, directly powering the ML models that drive safe, hands-free automation. The team operates in a 24x7, metrics-driven environment where precision and consistency are critical.

content.description:
About The Position

We're looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work.

On our Machine Learning team, you'll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges-large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment-that force us to search for novel techniques.

At Jane Street, our researchers, engineers, and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems, and run trading strategies. Depending on the day, we might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging distributed training performance, or studying how our model likes to trade in production.

We'll rely on your in-depth knowledge of the machine learning landscape and understanding of a variety of approaches-drawn from LLMs, image models, RL agents, recommendation systems, or classical ML methods-to shape the future of ML at Jane Street. You'll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. You'll also be hiring new colleagues, attending conferences, and teaching techniques to teammates-all of which we consider to be real and impactful parts of the job.

About You

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. There's no fixed set of skills we are looking for, but you should bring:

Practical experience working on empirical ML problemsThe ability to apply logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problemsIntellectual curiosity and excitement about state-of-the-art research across many ML problem domainsFluency with a versatile set of models and tricksThe hands-on coding skills needed to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas, in Python and your favorite ML frameworkAn eagerness to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of the team.

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

About The Role

Quvia is deploying Grid, our AI-powered platform that dynamically routes network traffic to optimize connectivity and performance, with enterprise customers in the U.S. We're looking for the engineer or scientist who makes it perform.

The core problem is getting finite satellite bandwidth to the right users at the right time, under contested and fast-changing conditions. Capacity shifts as satellites move, demand is bursty and mission-driven, and the answer has to be both good and fast. If you've built scheduling, network flow, or supply-chain optimization systems at scale, you already know the math. The domain is the only new part.

You'll be embedded with enterprise customer as the senior technical owner of Grid's optimization layer. This is hands-on work, not advisory. You'll formulate the models, write the code, choose the solvers, and profile the results yourself. You'll also translate in both directions: turning mission constraints into problems Grid can solve, and explaining what the models can and can't do in terms program leads can act on.

Eligibility: "U.S. citizenship required for this position"

What You'll Do

Formulate and build optimization models: Take the customer's operational problems - bandwidth allocation, routing, scheduling, capacity planning, contention resolution - and turn them into rigorous mathematical formulations, then implement them in production code.Develop and extend Grid's optimization capability: Modify and configure Grid directly against the engagement's requirements, and write new solvers, heuristics, and decomposition schemes where the existing capability doesn't reach.Own solver and algorithm selection: Decide where exact methods (MILP, network flow, constraint programming) are the right tool and where the problem demands heuristics, metaheuristics, decomposition, or a hybrid - and be able to defend the choice.Tune for hard runtime constraints: Live deployments impose real time budgets. Profile, reformulate, tighten relaxations, warm-start, and cut where needed to get quality solutions inside the window.Validate rigorously: Build the test harnesses, benchmark instances, and solution-quality measures that show a model is behaving correctly, including against edge cases the customer will eventually hit.Instrument and diagnose live systems: Debug degraded solution quality, infeasibility, and performance regressions in deployed environments where you cannot simply re-run offline.Document formulations, assumptions, and model behavior to a standard that holds up under government program review.Feed the roadmap: Bring field learnings back to Quvia's OR and engineering teams and identify where new optimization capability is needed in the product.Support the full engagement lifecycle: initial configuration, pilots, evaluation, and steady-state operation.

What You'll Need

U.S. Citizenship - Non-negotiable for this customer engagement.8+ years of professional experience developing and deploying optimization or operations research systems in production. Seniority and judgment are an explicit part of the bar; this is not a role we will fill with a strong junior.Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Operations Research or a closely related quantitative field. Computer Science and Electrical Engineering backgrounds are equally welcome where the optimization depth is there. Equivalent industry experience will be considered in place of the degree.Deep, applied command of optimization techniques: linear and mixed-integer programming, network flow, constraint programming, column generation or other decomposition methods, metaheuristics, and large-scale scheduling - with the practical experience to know which to reach for and when.Strong software engineering ability. You will write and ship the models yourself. Production-quality code in a compiled or high-performance language (Java, C++, or similar) alongside Python for modeling and analysis.Hands-on experience with commercial and open-source solvers - Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, HiGHS, or similar - including modeling APIs, parameter tuning, and callbacks.Track record of working directly with external customers or stakeholders on complex technical engagements, with the communication skills to hold a technical conversation and a program conversation on the same day.

Preferred Qualifications

AI/ML experience, particularly where learned components sit alongside or inside optimization systems: demand forecasting feeding an allocation model, learned heuristics or branching rules, or reinforcement learning for sequential decisions.Background in supply-chain, logistics, or delivery network optimization - the kind of work done at Amazon, DoorDash, Walmart Labs, or comparable operations at scale.Queueing theory and congestion modeling - characterizing contention, latency, and service levels when demand exceeds available capacity.Discrete-event and Monte Carlo simulation, and simulation-optimization where an analytical model alone won't capture the system's behavior.Stochastic, robust, and multi-stage optimization - recourse models, scenario generation, chance constraints, and designing for uncertainty rather than around it.Dynamic programming, Markov decision processes, and approximate DP for sequential allocation and control problems.Multi-objective optimization and trade-off analysis, including how to present a Pareto frontier to a decision-maker who has to choose a point on it.Graph and network algorithms - shortest path, max-flow/min-cut, matching, and network design at scale. Forecasting, time-series, and statistical modeling feeding operational models, plus design of experiments and sensitivity analysis to test how far a solution holds.Algebraic modeling languages - Pyomo, JuMP, AMPL, or GAMS - for rapid formulation and prototyping.High-performance and parallel computing applied to optimization: distributed solves, parallel heuristics, and profiling large model runs.

Work Conditions

U.S.-based with regular travel to and on-site work at customer locations.Some coordination with UK-based colleagues and stakeholders; occasional early or late calls to cover the time difference.

What We'll Offer

Connectivity and content engineering and business knowledgeOpportunity to work in cross-functional teamsCompetitive Salary401(k) with 100% match up to 4.0% after one year of serviceCompetitive health benefits, including optical and dentalLife InsurancePerformance BonusFlexible paid time off policyMonthly Phone Allowance

content.description:
Do you want to work for a world-renowned research institute that pushes the boundaries of biomedical science and health research? Right here in Montreal! At the Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC), you can be part of an organization focused on scientific discovery and innovation in patient-centered medicine. Join us today and make a difference!

Job Description

RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF THE MUHC

The Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC) is a world-renowned biomedical and hospital research centre. Located in Montreal, Quebec, the Institute is the research arm of the McGill University Health Centre (MUHC) affiliated with the Faculty of Medicine at McGill University. The RI-MUHC is supported in part by the Fonds de recherche du Québec - Santé (FRQS).

Position Summary

Department / Research Program: CVIS/IDIGH (MLOps & AI Development)

Our team at the Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC), in partnership with Polytechnique Montréal, is seeking a Programmer to join our multidisciplinary team. Our digital health projects include conversational AI applications supporting pediatric health information, HIV self-management, and HIV prevention and access to care. The position will primarily focus on MLOps, including CI/CD and model deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized environments, and system monitoring. The successful candidate will also contribute, when needed, to the development, integration, and evaluation of AI and machine-learning components.

General Duties

 Establish, maintain, and improve MLOps pipelines for conversational AI and related digital health projects. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, and deployment workflows. Manage cloud-based development and deployment environments and support application deployment across research and production environments. Develop and maintain containerized applications and services. Implement monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and system maintenance processes to support application and AI/ML system reliability and performance. Support infrastructure configuration, version control, release management, and deployment automation. Work with project developers to standardize development, testing, and deployment practices across projects. Support secure and scalable deployment of AI-enabled digital health applications. Contribute to the integration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large language models and other AI/ML components. Contribute, when needed, to model development, evaluation, and optimization. Maintain technical documentation to support system sustainability, reproducibility, and knowledge transfer. Collaborate with researchers, clinicians, and engineers across multidisciplinary digital health projects.

Website of the organization

https://rimuhc.ca/en

Education / Experience

Education: Bachelor's Degree

Field of Study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Work Experience: 2-5 years

Required Skills

 This position requires an advanced knowledge of oral and written French. An advanced knowledge of oral and written English is required, as the position requires regular and complex contact with patients, researchers or international students who are exclusively proficient in English. The position also requires complex writing or in-depth analysis of documents in English related to a research project. Experience with MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated application and/or model deployment workflows. Experience with cloud-based infrastructure and application deployment (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, etc.). Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker. Proficiency in Python and/or other relevant programming or scripting languages. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation, monitoring, and logging is an asset. Experience deploying, integrating, or maintaining AI/ML applications or large language models is an asset. Familiarity with machine learning and natural language processing frameworks, model serving, model versioning, experiment tracking, or inference optimization is an asset. Experience in digital health, health informatics, or clinical research environments is an asset. Familiarity with data privacy and security requirements in healthcare environments is an asset. Ability to work collaboratively with researchers, clinicians, engineers, and other members of multidisciplinary teams. Strong communication skills and ability to clearly document technical processes.

Additional information

Status: Temporary, full time (35-hour workweek)

Pay Scale: Commensurate with education and experience

Work Shift: Monday to Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm

Work Site: 5252 de Maisonneuve Blvd.

Additional specifications: This is an in-person position requiring on-site presence to support application deployment, testing, and collaboration with the lab team.

***If you wish to include a cover letter, please attach it with your resume in one document. ***

Why work with us?

 4-week vacation, 5th week after 5 years, Bank of 12 paid days (personal days and days for sickness or family obligations), 13 paid statutory holidays, Modular group insurance plan (including gender affirmation coverage),Telemedicine, RREGOP (defined benefit government pension plan), Training and professional development opportunities, Child Care Centres, Corporate Discounts (OPUS + Perkopolis), Competitive monthly parking rate, Employee Assistance Program, Recognition Program, Flex work options and much more!

https://rimuhc.ca/careers

To learn more about our benefits, please visit http://rimuhc.ca/en/compensation-and-benefits

THIS IS NOT A HOSPITAL POSITION.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates who self-identify as members of racialized groups/visible minorities, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, ethnic minorities, and 2SLGBTQIA+ persons. We also welcome candidates with the skills and knowledge to productively engage with diverse communities. Staff Software Engineer – Engineering Systems, Continuous Integration Team

Snowflake

Snowflake is an AI Data Cloud company that empowers enterprises to achieve their full potential through innovative data and AI solutions.

Snowflake is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.

Remote US-WA-Bellevue Full-time Posted today aidata-platformcloud

$236k–$339k Apply directly →

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help us build a world-class developer platform that fuels the Snowflake Data Cloud. As an engineer on the Continuous Integration team within Engineering Systems (ES), you will set the technical direction for and deliver the CI service that powers Snowflake's repositories and developer ecosystem.

Together with industry-wide experts in distributed systems, cross-cloud development, and engineering excellence, you will evolve our developer infrastructure and tooling to be elastic, large-scale, and highly performant — with simplicity at its core.

As a Staff Engineer on the CI team, you will help Snowflake realize its mission of becoming the premier Data Cloud by accelerating the delivery of high-quality software to production. You will set the technical standard for the team, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers across the organization, and partner with product and engineering leadership to chart the quarterly and long-term roadmaps. You will ensure the team executes toward serving the current needs of its customers while staying ahead of technological trends and future demands.

As a Staff Software Engineer — Ci, You Will

 Own the technical direction and architecture of Snowflake's CI platform — designing systems that scale reliably across thousands of developers, millions of builds, and a rapidly growing multi-repository codebase Lead the design and implementation of distributed CI services that are elastic, performant, and fault-tolerant across cloud providers Drive the CI platform strategy — partner with product managers and engineering leadership to define quarterly and long-term roadmaps that balance customer needs with technical innovation Set the engineering bar for the team through code reviews, design reviews, and architectural guidance — ensuring the CI platform is built with the quality and rigor expected of enterprise-grade infrastructure Identify and resolve systemic technical challenges — from build performance and resource efficiency to multi-tenant isolation, reliability, and security Mentor and develop engineers on the team — elevate technical judgment, design quality, and engineering craftsmanship across the group Stay ahead of the curve — evaluate and adopt emerging CI/CD technologies, tooling patterns, and industry best practices to keep Snowflake's developer platform at the leading edge Be a key stakeholder in cross-team initiatives that affect developer productivity — collaborating with adjacent ES teams and engineering leadership to shape the broader developer experience

Required

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 8+ years of industry experience designing and building distributed systems at scale A track record of technical leadership — owning system architecture, driving design decisions, and raising the technical bar for a team or organization Deep experience with enterprise-grade Continuous Integration for cloud-based distributed systems — you've built, scaled, or significantly evolved CI infrastructure at a comparable scale Strong passion for making developers highly productive — you think about developer experience as a product and are energized by making engineers faster and happier Excellent CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design Fluency in Java, C++, Python, or Go — with the versatility to work across languages and systems A strategic mindset — strong sense of what to prioritize for maximum impact and the ability to translate strategy into executable technical plans Ability to mentor and influence — you elevate engineers around you through code reviews, design guidance, and technical mentorship Excellent communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering and leadership audiences

Preferred

 Experience developing data systems or distributed systems internals Hands-on experience with Jenkins, Bazel, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or other CI/CD suites at scale Experience designing multi-tenant systems with focus on reliability, performance, isolation, and security Proven experience authoring roadmap documents, technical design docs, project plans, and RCAs Experience with build system optimization — caching strategies, parallelization, incremental builds, and resource scheduling Background in developer tooling or platform engineering organizations

Snowflake Values We're Looking For

 Get It Done — You ship high-quality systems at pace. You don't just design — you build, debug, and deliver. Own It — You treat the CI platform as your own. You anticipate where it will break at 10x scale and fix it before it does. Make Each Other the Best — You raise the bar for everyone around you. Code reviews, design feedback, and mentorship aren't side activities — they're core to how you work. Think Big — You see CI infrastructure as a strategic lever for Snowflake's engineering velocity, not just a build system. You design for the future.

Compensation

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Base Salary Range - Total Target Compensation

$236,000 – $354,000 - $271,400 – $407,100

Octopus Newsroom is looking for a technically strong, customer-facing engineer to support, install and upgrade our newsroom computer system (NRCS) for broadcasters across North America. You will solve problems in Linux, Docker and network environments, and you’ll also be the person our customers like talking to about upgrades, new features and how to get more out of Octopus.
About us
Octopus Newsroom develops a modern newsroom computer system used by broadcasters in more than 60 countries. We are headquartered in Prague, Czechia, EU, with offices in New York and Bangkok, and we support news, sports and live production teams across TV, radio and digital. Our North American customer base is growing fast, and we are growing the US team with it.
What you will do
Provide advanced technical support to TV newsrooms using Octopus, often close to air time.Troubleshoot using logs, configuration files, APIs and MOS device communication, then fix the issue or pass it to development with clear documentation.Install new systems and run upgrades, remotely and on site.Train customers and help them adopt new features.Talk with customers about upgrades, new modules and integrations, and join pre-sales calls as the technical expert next to our sales manager.Reproduce issues in test environments and help improve our documentation.
What you need
3+ years in technical support, implementation, systems engineering or solutions engineering, working directly with customers.Solid Linux server skills: services, CLI, permissions, logs.Hands-on experience with Docker and virtualized environments (VMware, Hyper-V or public cloud).Good networking knowledge: TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs, on-premise and data center setups.Comfortable reading API requests, logs, XML and JSON.Experience in broadcast, news or media technology, either at a broadcaster or at a vendor or integrator (NRCS, MAM, graphics, playout, automation, prompter).Clear communication with both engineers and non-technical users like producers and editors.Based in the US, close to a major airport, and able to travel several times a year in the US and abroad.
Nice to have (not a must)
Experience with Octopus, Avid iNEWS, AP ENPS, Dalet or another NRCS.MOS integrations with graphics, playout or prompter systems.Deploying or upgrading mission-critical systems in live environments.A mix of newsroom operations and IT experience.Pre-sales, scoping or technical account management experience.Spanish.
What to expect
Newsrooms run on deadlines. When a show is about to go live and something is not working, you own the problem until it is solved.You will work independently most of the time, organize your own workload and make your own decisions, with direct access to our support, development and product teams when you need them.Most work happens in business hours across US time zones, but sometimes a customer will need you outside them.
What we offer
Long-term, full-time role in a privately owned, profitable company with more than 25 years in broadcast.Fully remote within the US, with flexible scheduling.European-style paid time off, plus separate sick time.Base salary, plus performance bonus.401(k) with company contribution.Company contribution to medical, dental and vision coverage.Regular travel to broadcasters and industry events in the US and abroad, all expenses covered.Ongoing training on Octopus and related broadcast technologies.Company laptop, phone and home internet contribution.
How to apply
Apply through LinkedIn with a short note (3 to 6 sentences) covering:Your technical background: Linux, Docker or virtualization, networking.Your broadcast or newsroom experience: which systems you have used or supported, and your role.One customer situation you handled well.Where you are based in the US and when you could start.

content.description:
About Your Role 👀

As a Demand Gen Marketer at Pogo, you'll own B2B paid acquisition for a narrow, high-value audience - across digital, out-of-home, and unconventional channels.

Specifically, you will:

Run B2B paid acquisition across paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), out-of-home (billboards, direct mail), and other B2B channelsGet creative with targeting - geo-targeted campaigns around industry events, hyper-targeted ads by company and title, timing-based plays that reach the right person at the right momentContribute to channel and budget strategy alongside the team - work together to figure out what to test, scale, and cutApply analytical rigor to every spend decision - CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, attributionPartner with marketing, sales, and design on landing pages, ad creative, and full-funnel optimizationTest, iterate, and scale what works

About you 👩‍🚀

Likely 3–6 years of B2B paid acquisition experience at a SaaS company with meaningful paid spend. You've owned real budget, not a small line item. You've run multiple paid channels. LinkedIn, Meta, and beyond - you know how to make them work. You back every spend decision with data. CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, attribution - you have the rigor to defend your calls. You've worked at a fast-growing organization with real ownership. You don't need to be told what to do. Bonus: experience with AI tools in marketing workflows; out-of-home, billboard, or direct mail experience; experience marketing to data/insights buyers, market researchers, or brand teams. 

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌

Own B2B paid acquisition across multiple channels. You’ll run and shape paid strategy across digital and offline channels - from LinkedIn and Meta to billboards and direct mail - with real ownership over budget and performance. Work on a product with strong market pull. You’ll help scale a product that already has growing enterprise demand, giving you the opportunity to optimize and accelerate something that customers genuinely want. Blend strategy with execution. This role is not just campaign management. You’ll influence channel mix, budget allocation, landing pages, creative, positioning, and full-funnel conversion strategy alongside the broader GTM team. Experiment beyond traditional B2B channels. We're excited about unconventional distribution and creative marketing ideas, especially across out-of-home, direct mail, and high-attention brand moments. Solve a real targeting challenge. Our buyers are a specific, senior audience - you won't scale through volume alone. This role rewards creative, precision targeting over brute-force spend. Join a highly analytical and product-minded team. We care deeply about measurement, iteration, and craft. You’ll work with people who think rigorously about growth and care about building excellent customer experiences. 

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

This is not a pure “media buyer” role. We expect paid marketers to think beyond campaign execution - into positioning, landing pages, creative strategy, attribution, and pipeline impact. We care deeply about efficiency and accountability. Every dollar spent is scrutinized through CAC, ROAS, attribution, and pipeline contribution. You need to enjoy operating with rigor and defending decisions with data. Things change quickly. Budgets, channels, and priorities may shift rapidly based on performance and market feedback. We optimize aggressively and don’t get overly attached to past strategies. You'll need to thrive with autonomy. There won't be overly structured playbooks or layers of management. We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, make decisions, and execute quickly. We expect more than 9 to 5 - raw hours make an impact at our current stage. That said, we trust each team member to create a flexible work schedule that allows them to be most productive while accommodating other priorities outside of work. We also strongly encourage time off to recharge the batteries: in addition to unlimited PTO, we've implemented a minimum 20 days vacation policy 🌴

Department: Marketing

Location: Atlanta

Description

Infor is looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous Senior Digital Performance Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team, working closely with the hiring supervisor, on B2B performance analysis. This role owns performance measurement across the full digital funnel — from website and paid media engagement through form fills, MQLs, sales opportunities, and pipeline — and will work closely with the Paid Media team, the Web team, and marketing leadership to get there. You'll be the connective layer between top-of-funnel digital activity and downstream revenue outcomes, translating fragmented data from web, paid, and CRM systems into a coherent view of what's driving (or holding back) growth. This is a senior, largely self-directed role: you'll be trusted to define the analytical approach, not just execute against a spec.

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

Own end-to-end funnel analytics — connect web, paid media, and AI/LLM-driven engagement to form fills, MQLs, opportunities, and closed-won pipeline, identifying where and why prospects convert or drop off, and use AI tooling to accelerate diagnostics and reporting turnaround.Own web analytics using GA4, Looker Studio, and related tooling — actively monitor organic, direct, and referral channels alongside on-site conversion and content/landing page performance, and own visibility and traffic from AI/LLM search surfaces (e.g., AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) as an emerging discovery channel — while continuously improving tracking fidelity (event tracking, UTMs, GA4 configuration, tagging governance).Own paid media analytics across paid search, paid social, and programmatic/display — surface reallocation opportunities, testing recommendations, and efficiency actions across channel and campaign performance, audience/creative testing, and attribution across a multi-touch buyer journey.Build and maintain the reporting and dashboard layer that gives marketing and sales leadership a single, trustworthy view of funnel health, channel ROI, and pipeline contribution — designed for executive consumption, not just raw output — and document methodology and definitions so metrics stay consistent as the team scales.Drive conversion-rate diagnostics and CRO — form and test hypotheses on where and why prospects drop off, and partner with the Web team and business stakeholders to recommend and implement fixes, rather than reporting findings in isolation.Own data integrity end-to-end — partner with the Paid Media team, Web team, marketing leadership, RevOps, content, design, and engineering to close tracking and data-quality gaps across the Paid Media platforms → GA4 → CRM → data warehouse chain; audit and reconcile discrepancies across GA4, ad platforms, Salesforce, and the data warehouse, and build monitoring so issues are caught before they reach a dashboard.

Basic Qualifications

True North Social is a full-service digital marketing agency specializing in social media marketing, paid advertising, creative content production, website design, SEO, and e-commerce. Strategy, Analytics & CollaborationUse campaign data to identify performance trends, creative opportunities, and areas for improvement.Develop actionable strategies to improve client acquisition, lead generation, and e-commerce sales.Prepare campaign performance reports and communicate results, insights, and recommendations.Collaborate with account managers, creative teams, and clients to align advertising strategies with broader marketing objectives.Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns while maintaining strong attention to detail and deadlines.
QualificationsProven experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.Strong understanding of paid media strategy, campaign optimization, audience targeting, and performance marketing.Demonstrated ability to develop creative strategies and produce high-performing advertising content.Hands-on experience creating static image ads, short-form video ads, and compelling advertising copy.Proficiency with creative tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar platforms.Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate advertising data into actionable creative and campaign strategies.Experience with A/B testing, creative testing frameworks, and conversion optimization.Familiarity with e-commerce advertising, lead generation, and digital marketing best practices.Knowledge of advertising performance metrics, tracking platforms, and reporting tools.Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and internal teams.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

Optimum is a leading provider of Mobile, Broadband (DOCSIS, Fiber) and Video services in the United States.  The Product Development organization is responsible for the technology enablement and development of these technologies for our customers along with the tools used by our teams to support them. Reporting to the Quality Engineering Manager, the SQE I QA Automation Engineering for web and mobile products will participate as part of a highly skilled software development team to accelerate the automation of our web and mobile products’ end-to-end testing capabilities (both ecomm/agent web, iOS and android).   

We are looking for a passionate and engaged individual who is willing to take on the challenge of transforming software development at a Fortune 500 company and building the tools that will allow our development teams to Go Fast!   

Responsibilities

Assist in automating our end-to-end testing capabilities across all web and mobile products to 80% coverage including products for broadband, video, customer support and technician support tools.  Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks (In either Java or Python) to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.    Introduce capabilities to do effective A/B testing of releases across test populations.  Contribute to a structured knowledge base (Atlassian Confluence) that allows teams to create, maintain and extend documentation for all our developer tools and processes.  Implement tools to identify, document and track software defects (Qase/Jira).   Work closely with the development teams to resolve issues and ensure timely fixes.  Follow process improvement initiatives to enhance testing practices, tools, and metrologies.  Implement tools to monitor and report on key quality metrics including defect rates, test coverage and test execution progress. Ability to make/maintain API suites a must! Establish and gain acceptance for Key Results indicated by our development pipeline and automation test frameworks. Ability to work on a team both under Senior Quality Engineers, and alongside other discipline members.

At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

Description

The GO-AI Operations team is building the future of workplace safety at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers through an advanced AI-powered human detection system rated at SIL2 (Safety Integrity Level 2), achieving up to 99% accuracy in identifying human presence. The team works at the intersection of computer vision and operational safety, processing multi-modal image data — including RGB, thermal, and grayscale feeds — to train and validate ML models that protect associates on the fulfillment floor. As an Associate in this role, you will perform high-quality 2D image annotation, accurately segmenting humans, robots, and carts within defined Regions of Interest (ROI). Your work directly enables the ML pipeline that powers real-time safety decisions, making this a high-impact, metrics-driven operational role where precision and consistency are critical. If you thrive in structured environments, have a sharp eye for detail, and want your work to directly contribute to associate safety at scale, this is the role for you

Key job responsibilities

Perform accurate 2D segmentation and annotation of humans, robots, and carts across RGB and thermal images using annotation tools (e.g., CVAT, SageMaker Ground Truth)

Identify and annotate objects within the defined Region of Interest (ROI), while applying masks outside the ROI as per guidelines

Interpret multi-feed image data (RGB, thermal, grayscale) with high precision, distinguishing between overlapping or partially occluded objects

Maintain high accuracy and productivity metrics aligned with program expectations and weekly targets

Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and quality guidelines consistently across all annotation tasks

Review and validate annotations to ensure defect-free outputs, flagging edge cases or ambiguous frames for escalation

Quickly adapt to feedback from quality audits and apply learnings to improve annotation quality in subsequent batches

Participate in training and nesting phases, achieving ramp-up within defined timelines and demonstrating readiness through qualification assessments

Maintain data confidentiality and adhere to security protocols when handling image and video data from fulfillment centers

Collaborate with team leads and quality analysts to support continuous improvement in annotation accuracy and throughput

A day in the life

Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.

Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.

About The Team

The GO-AI Operations team is part of Amazon's Global Operations AI organization, enabling automation and workplace safety at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. The team supports an advanced SIL2-rated human detection system achieving up to 99% accuracy in identifying human presence within robotic work cells. By processing multi-modal image data — RGB, thermal, and grayscale — the team performs high-quality 2D segmentation and annotation of humans, robots, and carts, directly powering the ML models that drive safe, hands-free automation. The team operates in a 24x7, metrics-driven environment where precision and consistency are critical.

 Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

content.description:
About The Position

We're looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work.

On our Machine Learning team, you'll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges-large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment-that force us to search for novel techniques.

At Jane Street, our researchers, engineers, and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems, and run trading strategies. Depending on the day, we might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging distributed training performance, or studying how our model likes to trade in production.

We'll rely on your in-depth knowledge of the machine learning landscape and understanding of a variety of approaches-drawn from LLMs, image models, RL agents, recommendation systems, or classical ML methods-to shape the future of ML at Jane Street. You'll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. You'll also be hiring new colleagues, attending conferences, and teaching techniques to teammates-all of which we consider to be real and impactful parts of the job.

About You

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. There's no fixed set of skills we are looking for, but you should bring:

Practical experience working on empirical ML problemsThe ability to apply logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problemsIntellectual curiosity and excitement about state-of-the-art research across many ML problem domainsFluency with a versatile set of models and tricksThe hands-on coding skills needed to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas, in Python and your favorite ML frameworkAn eagerness to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of the team.

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

content.description:
About Quvia

Quvia is building the digital fabric between edge and cloud. Our platform uses AI and machine learning to orchestrate connectivity across satellite, terrestrial, and hybrid networks so customers can move and manage data in the world's most network constrained environments.

We partner with global leaders in aviation, maritime, energy and other industries where connectivity is variable and complex, and digital services depend on reliable data movement. As companies deploy AI, automation and data-driven systems at the edge, Quvia provides the platform needed to unlock the full potential of their data and build value above the network.

Quvia is a fast growing, Series A company backed by Colombia Capital ($5B+ in fund commitments. It is headquartered in the greater Miami are with offices in the UK and India.

Learn more at www.quvia.ai and www.linkedin.com/company/quvia.

Why Quvia?

Founded in 2019, we are a fast-growing, Series A tech startup passionate about making connectivity experiences better for everyone.Our industry-first solutions are already addressing major challenges for companies in the travel and transportation industries-and we're just getting started.As an early-stage company, new hires will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our growth trajectory.We are headquartered in the greater Miami region, with remote teams spanning the U.S., Europe, and India.Quvia is backed by Columbia Capital, a respected venture capital firm founded in 1989 that has raised over $5 Bn of fund commitments.

About The Role

Quvia is deploying Grid, our AI-powered platform that dynamically routes network traffic to optimize connectivity and performance, with enterprise customers in the U.S. We're looking for the engineer or scientist who makes it perform.

The core problem is getting finite satellite bandwidth to the right users at the right time, under contested and fast-changing conditions. Capacity shifts as satellites move, demand is bursty and mission-driven, and the answer has to be both good and fast. If you've built scheduling, network flow, or supply-chain optimization systems at scale, you already know the math. The domain is the only new part.

You'll be embedded with enterprise customer as the senior technical owner of Grid's optimization layer. This is hands-on work, not advisory. You'll formulate the models, write the code, choose the solvers, and profile the results yourself. You'll also translate in both directions: turning mission constraints into problems Grid can solve, and explaining what the models can and can't do in terms program leads can act on.

Eligibility: "U.S. citizenship required for this position"

What You'll Do

Formulate and build optimization models: Take the customer's operational problems - bandwidth allocation, routing, scheduling, capacity planning, contention resolution - and turn them into rigorous mathematical formulations, then implement them in production code.Develop and extend Grid's optimization capability: Modify and configure Grid directly against the engagement's requirements, and write new solvers, heuristics, and decomposition schemes where the existing capability doesn't reach.Own solver and algorithm selection: Decide where exact methods (MILP, network flow, constraint programming) are the right tool and where the problem demands heuristics, metaheuristics, decomposition, or a hybrid - and be able to defend the choice.Tune for hard runtime constraints: Live deployments impose real time budgets. Profile, reformulate, tighten relaxations, warm-start, and cut where needed to get quality solutions inside the window.Validate rigorously: Build the test harnesses, benchmark instances, and solution-quality measures that show a model is behaving correctly, including against edge cases the customer will eventually hit.Instrument and diagnose live systems: Debug degraded solution quality, infeasibility, and performance regressions in deployed environments where you cannot simply re-run offline.Document formulations, assumptions, and model behavior to a standard that holds up under government program review.Feed the roadmap: Bring field learnings back to Quvia's OR and engineering teams and identify where new optimization capability is needed in the product.Support the full engagement lifecycle: initial configuration, pilots, evaluation, and steady-state operation.

What You'll Need

U.S. Citizenship - Non-negotiable for this customer engagement.8+ years of professional experience developing and deploying optimization or operations research systems in production. Seniority and judgment are an explicit part of the bar; this is not a role we will fill with a strong junior.Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Operations Research or a closely related quantitative field. Computer Science and Electrical Engineering backgrounds are equally welcome where the optimization depth is there. Equivalent industry experience will be considered in place of the degree.Deep, applied command of optimization techniques: linear and mixed-integer programming, network flow, constraint programming, column generation or other decomposition methods, metaheuristics, and large-scale scheduling - with the practical experience to know which to reach for and when.Strong software engineering ability. You will write and ship the models yourself. Production-quality code in a compiled or high-performance language (Java, C++, or similar) alongside Python for modeling and analysis.Hands-on experience with commercial and open-source solvers - Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, HiGHS, or similar - including modeling APIs, parameter tuning, and callbacks.Track record of working directly with external customers or stakeholders on complex technical engagements, with the communication skills to hold a technical conversation and a program conversation on the same day.

Preferred Qualifications

AI/ML experience, particularly where learned components sit alongside or inside optimization systems: demand forecasting feeding an allocation model, learned heuristics or branching rules, or reinforcement learning for sequential decisions.Background in supply-chain, logistics, or delivery network optimization - the kind of work done at Amazon, DoorDash, Walmart Labs, or comparable operations at scale.Queueing theory and congestion modeling - characterizing contention, latency, and service levels when demand exceeds available capacity.Discrete-event and Monte Carlo simulation, and simulation-optimization where an analytical model alone won't capture the system's behavior.Stochastic, robust, and multi-stage optimization - recourse models, scenario generation, chance constraints, and designing for uncertainty rather than around it.Dynamic programming, Markov decision processes, and approximate DP for sequential allocation and control problems.Multi-objective optimization and trade-off analysis, including how to present a Pareto frontier to a decision-maker who has to choose a point on it.Graph and network algorithms - shortest path, max-flow/min-cut, matching, and network design at scale. Forecasting, time-series, and statistical modeling feeding operational models, plus design of experiments and sensitivity analysis to test how far a solution holds.Algebraic modeling languages - Pyomo, JuMP, AMPL, or GAMS - for rapid formulation and prototyping.High-performance and parallel computing applied to optimization: distributed solves, parallel heuristics, and profiling large model runs.

Work Conditions

U.S.-based with regular travel to and on-site work at customer locations.Some coordination with UK-based colleagues and stakeholders; occasional early or late calls to cover the time difference.

What We'll Offer

Connectivity and content engineering and business knowledgeOpportunity to work in cross-functional teamsCompetitive Salary401(k) with 100% match up to 4.0% after one year of serviceCompetitive health benefits, including optical and dentalLife InsurancePerformance BonusFlexible paid time off policyMonthly Phone Allowance

Do you want to work for a world-renowned research institute that pushes the boundaries of biomedical science and health research? Right here in Montreal! At the Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC), you can be part of an organization focused on scientific discovery and innovation in patient-centered medicine. Join us today and make a difference!

Job Description

RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF THE MUHC

The Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC) is a world-renowned biomedical and hospital research centre. Located in Montreal, Quebec, the Institute is the research arm of the McGill University Health Centre (MUHC) affiliated with the Faculty of Medicine at McGill University. The RI-MUHC is supported in part by the Fonds de recherche du Québec - Santé (FRQS).

Position Summary

Department / Research Program: CVIS/IDIGH (MLOps & AI Development)

Our team at the Research Institute of the McGill University Health Centre (RI-MUHC), in partnership with Polytechnique Montréal, is seeking a Programmer to join our multidisciplinary team. Our digital health projects include conversational AI applications supporting pediatric health information, HIV self-management, and HIV prevention and access to care. The position will primarily focus on MLOps, including CI/CD and model deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized environments, and system monitoring. The successful candidate will also contribute, when needed, to the development, integration, and evaluation of AI and machine-learning components.

General Duties

 Establish, maintain, and improve MLOps pipelines for conversational AI and related digital health projects. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, and deployment workflows. Manage cloud-based development and deployment environments and support application deployment across research and production environments. Develop and maintain containerized applications and services. Implement monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and system maintenance processes to support application and AI/ML system reliability and performance. Support infrastructure configuration, version control, release management, and deployment automation. Work with project developers to standardize development, testing, and deployment practices across projects. Support secure and scalable deployment of AI-enabled digital health applications. Contribute to the integration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large language models and other AI/ML components. Contribute, when needed, to model development, evaluation, and optimization. Maintain technical documentation to support system sustainability, reproducibility, and knowledge transfer. Collaborate with researchers, clinicians, and engineers across multidisciplinary digital health projects.

https://rimuhc.ca/en

Education / Experience

Education: Bachelor's Degree

Field of Study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Work Experience: 2-5 years

Required Skills

 This position requires an advanced knowledge of oral and written French. An advanced knowledge of oral and written English is required, as the position requires regular and complex contact with patients, researchers or international students who are exclusively proficient in English. The position also requires complex writing or in-depth analysis of documents in English related to a research project. Experience with MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated application and/or model deployment workflows. Experience with cloud-based infrastructure and application deployment (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, etc.). Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker. Proficiency in Python and/or other relevant programming or scripting languages. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation, monitoring, and logging is an asset. Experience deploying, integrating, or maintaining AI/ML applications or large language models is an asset. Familiarity with machine learning and natural language processing frameworks, model serving, model versioning, experiment tracking, or inference optimization is an asset. Experience in digital health, health informatics, or clinical research environments is an asset. Familiarity with data privacy and security requirements in healthcare environments is an asset. Ability to work collaboratively with researchers, clinicians, engineers, and other members of multidisciplinary teams. Strong communication skills and ability to clearly document technical processes.

Additional information

Octopus Newsroom is looking for a technically strong, customer-facing engineer to support, install and upgrade our newsroom computer system (NRCS) for broadcasters across North America. You will solve problems in Linux, Docker and network environments, and you’ll also be the person our customers like talking to about upgrades, new features and how to get more out of Octopus.
About us
Octopus Newsroom develops a modern newsroom computer system used by broadcasters in more than 60 countries. We are headquartered in Prague, Czechia, EU, with offices in New York and Bangkok, and we support news, sports and live production teams across TV, radio and digital. Our North American customer base is growing fast, and we are growing the US team with it.
What you will do
Provide advanced technical support to TV newsrooms using Octopus, often close to air time.Troubleshoot using logs, configuration files, APIs and MOS device communication, then fix the issue or pass it to development with clear documentation.Install new systems and run upgrades, remotely and on site.Train customers and help them adopt new features.Talk with customers about upgrades, new modules and integrations, and join pre-sales calls as the technical expert next to our sales manager.Reproduce issues in test environments and help improve our documentation.
What you need
3+ years in technical support, implementation, systems engineering or solutions engineering, working directly with customers.Solid Linux server skills: services, CLI, permissions, logs.Hands-on experience with Docker and virtualized environments (VMware, Hyper-V or public cloud).Good networking knowledge: TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs, on-premise and data center setups.Comfortable reading API requests, logs, XML and JSON.Experience in broadcast, news or media technology, either at a broadcaster or at a vendor or integrator (NRCS, MAM, graphics, playout, automation, prompter).Clear communication with both engineers and non-technical users like producers and editors.Based in the US, close to a major airport, and able to travel several times a year in the US and abroad.
Nice to have (not a must)
Experience with Octopus, Avid iNEWS, AP ENPS, Dalet or another NRCS.MOS integrations with graphics, playout or prompter systems.Deploying or upgrading mission-critical systems in live environments.A mix of newsroom operations and IT experience.Pre-sales, scoping or technical account management experience.Spanish.
What to expect
Newsrooms run on deadlines. When a show is about to go live and something is not working, you own the problem until it is solved.You will work independently most of the time, organize your own workload and make your own decisions, with direct access to our support, development and product teams when you need them.Most work happens in business hours across US time zones, but sometimes a customer will need you outside them.
What we offer
Long-term, full-time role in a privately owned, profitable company with more than 25 years in broadcast.Fully remote within the US, with flexible scheduling.European-style paid time off, plus separate sick time.Base salary, plus performance bonus.401(k) with company contribution.Company contribution to medical, dental and vision coverage.Regular travel to broadcasters and industry events in the US and abroad, all expenses covered.Ongoing training on Octopus and related broadcast technologies.Company laptop, phone and home internet contribution.
How to apply
Apply through LinkedIn with a short note (3 to 6 sentences) covering:Your technical background: Linux, Docker or virtualization, networking.Your broadcast or newsroom experience: which systems you have used or supported, and your role.One customer situation you handled well.Where you are based in the US and when you could start.

content.description:
About Your Role 👀

As a Demand Gen Marketer at Pogo, you'll own B2B paid acquisition for a narrow, high-value audience - across digital, out-of-home, and unconventional channels.

Specifically, you will:

Run B2B paid acquisition across paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), out-of-home (billboards, direct mail), and other B2B channelsGet creative with targeting - geo-targeted campaigns around industry events, hyper-targeted ads by company and title, timing-based plays that reach the right person at the right momentContribute to channel and budget strategy alongside the team - work together to figure out what to test, scale, and cutApply analytical rigor to every spend decision - CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, attributionPartner with marketing, sales, and design on landing pages, ad creative, and full-funnel optimizationTest, iterate, and scale what works

About you 👩‍🚀

Likely 3–6 years of B2B paid acquisition experience at a SaaS company with meaningful paid spend. You've owned real budget, not a small line item. You've run multiple paid channels. LinkedIn, Meta, and beyond - you know how to make them work. You back every spend decision with data. CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, attribution - you have the rigor to defend your calls. You've worked at a fast-growing organization with real ownership. You don't need to be told what to do. Bonus: experience with AI tools in marketing workflows; out-of-home, billboard, or direct mail experience; experience marketing to data/insights buyers, market researchers, or brand teams. 

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌

Own B2B paid acquisition across multiple channels. You’ll run and shape paid strategy across digital and offline channels - from LinkedIn and Meta to billboards and direct mail - with real ownership over budget and performance. Work on a product with strong market pull. You’ll help scale a product that already has growing enterprise demand, giving you the opportunity to optimize and accelerate something that customers genuinely want. Blend strategy with execution. This role is not just campaign management. You’ll influence channel mix, budget allocation, landing pages, creative, positioning, and full-funnel conversion strategy alongside the broader GTM team. Experiment beyond traditional B2B channels. We're excited about unconventional distribution and creative marketing ideas, especially across out-of-home, direct mail, and high-attention brand moments. Solve a real targeting challenge. Our buyers are a specific, senior audience - you won't scale through volume alone. This role rewards creative, precision targeting over brute-force spend. Join a highly analytical and product-minded team. We care deeply about measurement, iteration, and craft. You’ll work with people who think rigorously about growth and care about building excellent customer experiences. 

Why you might not be excited about us 👎

This is not a pure “media buyer” role. We expect paid marketers to think beyond campaign execution - into positioning, landing pages, creative strategy, attribution, and pipeline impact. We care deeply about efficiency and accountability. Every dollar spent is scrutinized through CAC, ROAS, attribution, and pipeline contribution. You need to enjoy operating with rigor and defending decisions with data. Things change quickly. Budgets, channels, and priorities may shift rapidly based on performance and market feedback. We optimize aggressively and don’t get overly attached to past strategies. You'll need to thrive with autonomy. There won't be overly structured playbooks or layers of management. We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, make decisions, and execute quickly. We expect more than 9 to 5 - raw hours make an impact at our current stage. That said, we trust each team member to create a flexible work schedule that allows them to be most productive while accommodating other priorities outside of work. We also strongly encourage time off to recharge the batteries: in addition to unlimited PTO, we've implemented a minimum 20 days vacation policy 🌴

Description

Infor is looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous Senior Digital Performance Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team, working closely with the hiring supervisor, on B2B performance analysis. This role owns performance measurement across the full digital funnel — from website and paid media engagement through form fills, MQLs, sales opportunities, and pipeline — and will work closely with the Paid Media team, the Web team, and marketing leadership to get there. You'll be the connective layer between top-of-funnel digital activity and downstream revenue outcomes, translating fragmented data from web, paid, and CRM systems into a coherent view of what's driving (or holding back) growth. This is a senior, largely self-directed role: you'll be trusted to define the analytical approach, not just execute against a spec.

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

Own end-to-end funnel analytics — connect web, paid media, and AI/LLM-driven engagement to form fills, MQLs, opportunities, and closed-won pipeline, identifying where and why prospects convert or drop off, and use AI tooling to accelerate diagnostics and reporting turnaround.Own web analytics using GA4, Looker Studio, and related tooling — actively monitor organic, direct, and referral channels alongside on-site conversion and content/landing page performance, and own visibility and traffic from AI/LLM search surfaces (e.g., AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) as an emerging discovery channel — while continuously improving tracking fidelity (event tracking, UTMs, GA4 configuration, tagging governance).Own paid media analytics across paid search, paid social, and programmatic/display — surface reallocation opportunities, testing recommendations, and efficiency actions across channel and campaign performance, audience/creative testing, and attribution across a multi-touch buyer journey.Build and maintain the reporting and dashboard layer that gives marketing and sales leadership a single, trustworthy view of funnel health, channel ROI, and pipeline contribution — designed for executive consumption, not just raw output — and document methodology and definitions so metrics stay consistent as the team scales.Drive conversion-rate diagnostics and CRO — form and test hypotheses on where and why prospects drop off, and partner with the Web team and business stakeholders to recommend and implement fixes, rather than reporting findings in isolation.Own data integrity end-to-end — partner with the Paid Media team, Web team, marketing leadership, RevOps, content, design, and engineering to close tracking and data-quality gaps across the Paid Media platforms → GA4 → CRM → data warehouse chain; audit and reconcile discrepancies across GA4, ad platforms, Salesforce, and the data warehouse, and build monitoring so issues are caught before they reach a dashboard.

Experience in digital/marketing analytics, with ownership of both web analytics and paid media analytics.Experience connecting top-of-funnel web/paid data to downstream outcomes — form fills, MQLs, sales opportunities, and pipeline/revenue.Experience with Ad Platforms, GA4 and Looker Studio (or equivalent BI tooling), including custom configuration, not just report consumption.Experience with CRM/marketing data (e.g., Salesforce, marketing automation platforms) and how funnel stages are defined and tracked.Experience turning ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.Understanding of digital marketing channels (SEO, paid search, paid social, display/programmatic, email) and how they interact across the funnel.Experience in a B2B or account-based marketing environment.Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship.
