Company Description
True North Social is a full-service digital marketing agency specializing in social media marketing, paid advertising, creative content production, website design, SEO, and e-commerce. With over a decade of experience, we help brands grow through strategic marketing, compelling creative, and data-driven advertising campaigns.
We believe successful digital marketing happens when strong creative meets smart strategy. Our team combines visually engaging content with performance-focused marketing to help clients reach their audiences, increase conversions, and achieve measurable business growth.
Role Description
We are seeking a Performance Marketing & Creative Strategist to join our team full-time.This role combines paid media buying, creative strategy, and hands-on ad creation. The ideal candidate understands not only how to build, manage, and optimize successful advertising campaigns but also how to develop compelling creative that drives engagement, conversions, and revenue.
You will be responsible for managing paid advertising campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, and TikTok while developing creative strategies, producing ad assets, testing new concepts, and using performance data to continuously improve results.
We're looking for someone who is both analytical and creative — someone who can identify why an ad is performing, develop ideas to improve it, and execute those ideas.
Key Responsibilities
Paid Media Management & OptimizationPlan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.Develop comprehensive paid media strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences, and budgets.Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, placements, and conversion optimization.Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates.Conduct A/B testing across audiences, messaging, creative assets, and campaign structures.Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations to improve results.Stay current with platform updates, advertising best practices, and emerging digital marketing trends.
Creative Strategy & Ad ProductionDevelop performance-driven creative strategies for paid social advertising campaigns.Conceptualize and create compelling static image ads, video ads, and other digital advertising assets.Write engaging ad copy, headlines, hooks, and calls to action tailored to specific audiences and platforms.Identify creative trends, successful advertising formats, and opportunities to test new concepts.Develop creative briefs, ad concepts, and content recommendations based on campaign performance and audience insights.Collaborate with internal designers, video editors, and content creators to produce high-performing ad creative.Independently create and edit advertising assets when needed.Continuously test creative variations to improve engagement, conversion rates, and overall advertising performance.
Strategy, Analytics & CollaborationUse campaign data to identify performance trends, creative opportunities, and areas for improvement.Develop actionable strategies to improve client acquisition, lead generation, and e-commerce sales.Prepare campaign performance reports and communicate results, insights, and recommendations.Collaborate with account managers, creative teams, and clients to align advertising strategies with broader marketing objectives.Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns while maintaining strong attention to detail and deadlines.
QualificationsProven experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.Strong understanding of paid media strategy, campaign optimization, audience targeting, and performance marketing.Demonstrated ability to develop creative strategies and produce high-performing advertising content.Hands-on experience creating static image ads, short-form video ads, and compelling advertising copy.Proficiency with creative tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar platforms.Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate advertising data into actionable creative and campaign strategies.Experience with A/B testing, creative testing frameworks, and conversion optimization.Familiarity with e-commerce advertising, lead generation, and digital marketing best practices.Knowledge of advertising performance metrics, tracking platforms, and reporting tools.Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and internal teams.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
Preferred QualificationsExperience working at a digital marketing agency and managing multiple client accounts.Experience developing and editing short-form video advertisements for Instagram Reels, Facebook, and TikTok.Understanding of direct-response advertising, consumer psychology, and conversion-focused creative.Familiarity with Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.Experience developing advertising strategies for both e-commerce and service-based businesses.Ability to independently take an advertising concept from initial strategy through creative production, campaign launch, and optimization.
Salary$75,000 annually
BenefitsUnlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)Health insurance reimbursement (set amount)401(k)
What We're Looking ForWe're looking for someone who understands that great advertising is about more than media buying. The right candidate knows how to combine data, creativity, and strategic thinking to produce campaigns that perform.
You should be comfortable moving between analyzing campaign metrics, brainstorming creative concepts, designing or editing ads, writing compelling copy, and optimizing campaigns.
If you're passionate about both the creative and analytical sides of digital advertising and enjoy seeing your ideas translate into measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!

Job Summary

Optimum is a leading provider of Mobile, Broadband (DOCSIS, Fiber) and Video services in the United States.  The Product Development organization is responsible for the technology enablement and development of these technologies for our customers along with the tools used by our teams to support them. Reporting to the Quality Engineering Manager, the SQE I QA Automation Engineering for web and mobile products will participate as part of a highly skilled software development team to accelerate the automation of our web and mobile products’ end-to-end testing capabilities (both ecomm/agent web, iOS and android).   

We are looking for a passionate and engaged individual who is willing to take on the challenge of transforming software development at a Fortune 500 company and building the tools that will allow our development teams to Go Fast!   

Responsibilities

Assist in automating our end-to-end testing capabilities across all web and mobile products to 80% coverage including products for broadband, video, customer support and technician support tools.  Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks (In either Java or Python) to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.    Introduce capabilities to do effective A/B testing of releases across test populations.  Contribute to a structured knowledge base (Atlassian Confluence) that allows teams to create, maintain and extend documentation for all our developer tools and processes.  Implement tools to identify, document and track software defects (Qase/Jira).   Work closely with the development teams to resolve issues and ensure timely fixes.  Follow process improvement initiatives to enhance testing practices, tools, and metrologies.  Implement tools to monitor and report on key quality metrics including defect rates, test coverage and test execution progress. Ability to make/maintain API suites a must! Establish and gain acceptance for Key Results indicated by our development pipeline and automation test frameworks. Ability to work on a team both under Senior Quality Engineers, and alongside other discipline members. 

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent experienceMinimum 3 years of experience in software development, automation, and tools with at least 1 year experience in web automation. Proficiency in variety of programming languages (Python or Java is a must), not just within framework guidelines. Experience with Google cloud or Amazon Web Services and their capabilitiesUnderstanding of software methodologies and DevOps practicesExperience with the implementation and optimization CI/CD PipelinesExperience with the automation of test casesGood intuition for software design, actively looking to learn from other teams and projectsExperience with data formats and locality with performance considerationsDemonstrated experience solving performance and data issues by applying experience/knowledgeCompletely comfortable working with live production systems, debugging issues and taking careful actions with protections against damageContributes to establishing and maintaining corporate policies related to technology 

At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stop.

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.
